install: set -euo pipefail; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input --upgrade pip; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input -e '.[dev]' bandit pip-audit; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; VENV_LINE='export PATH="'"$(pwd)/.venv/bin"':$PATH"'; grep -qxF "$VENV_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$VENV_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
